# ChallanSetu

> Challan Setu helps Delhi NCR vehicle owners legally settle traffic challans through Lok Adalat and lawyer support, saving up to 50% on eligible fines. No court visit required. Zero convenience fee. Money-back guarantee if settlement is not achieved.

ChallanSetu is an independent private platform — not affiliated with any government department, traffic police, or RTO. It provides challan assistance, settlement guidance, and legal support via Lok Adalat for vehicle owners in Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, and Faridabad.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.challansetu.com): Submit vehicle number to check traffic challan discount eligibility. Save up to 50% on fines via Lok Adalat settlement. Serving Delhi NCR.
- [How It Works](https://www.challansetu.com/how-it-works): 3-step process — submit vehicle number, share challan details, receive settlement option. No upfront payment. No court visit.
- [FAQ](https://www.challansetu.com/faq): Answers to common questions about challan eligibility, Lok Adalat settlement, safety, payment, and the ChallanSetu process.
- [Cities](https://www.challansetu.com/cities): Traffic challan support available in Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, and Faridabad.
- [Service Area](https://www.challansetu.com/service-area): Detailed challan coverage information for Delhi NCR — which challan types are supported in each city.
- [About](https://www.challansetu.com/about): ChallanSetu's mission, values, contact details, and service area.

## Drink & Drive Challan Assistance

Legal support for drink-and-drive (Section 185, Motor Vehicles Act) cases: court
representation, licence-suspension appeals, and Lok Adalat settlement where the
case is eligible. These are court challans, not e-challans — they cannot be paid
online and require a court appearance, which ChallanSetu handles on your behalf.

- [Drink & Drive Challan Help](https://www.challansetu.com/drink-and-drive): Overview of penalties, court process, licence suspension, and legal options for drink-and-drive cases in India.
- [Delhi Drink & Drive Challan](https://www.challansetu.com/drink-and-drive/delhi): Local court process, penalties, and legal representation for drink-and-drive cases in Delhi.
- [Gurgaon Drink & Drive Challan](https://www.challansetu.com/drink-and-drive/gurgaon): Local court process, penalties, and legal representation for drink-and-drive cases in Gurgaon.
- [Noida Drink & Drive Challan](https://www.challansetu.com/drink-and-drive/noida): Local court process, penalties, and legal representation for drink-and-drive cases in Noida.
- [Ghaziabad Drink & Drive Challan](https://www.challansetu.com/drink-and-drive/ghaziabad): Local court process, penalties, and legal representation for drink-and-drive cases in Ghaziabad.
- [Faridabad Drink & Drive Challan](https://www.challansetu.com/drink-and-drive/faridabad): Local court process, penalties, and legal representation for drink-and-drive cases in Faridabad.
- [Chandigarh Drink & Drive Challan](https://www.challansetu.com/drink-and-drive/chandigarh): Local court process, penalties, and legal representation for drink-and-drive cases in Chandigarh.
- [Mumbai Drink & Drive Challan](https://www.challansetu.com/drink-and-drive/mumbai): Local court process, penalties, and legal representation for drink-and-drive cases in Mumbai.

## Key Facts

- Settlement service area: Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, Faridabad (Delhi NCR)
- E-challan check coverage: all 35 Indian states and union territories
- Typical savings: 30–50% on eligible traffic challans
- Process: Lok Adalat settlement managed by a dedicated lawyer
- Court visit required: No
- Upfront payment: Not required to check eligibility
- Guarantee: Full money-back if settlement is not achieved

- Support hours: Monday–Saturday, 9am–6pm IST
